Six-week group for perimenopause

Not sleeping?Not feeling like yourself?

Strong and Calm is a small group for women in perimenopause who are tired of being tired. Two sessions a week: gentle strength training in the gym, then slow, unheated yoga to help with sleep and stress.

Book your placeCompare all groups

Starts Tuesday 10 November. Or text Helen on 07718 339510

Is this for you?

  • Your sleep, mood or energy has changed and you're not sure why it's happening now
  • You've heard that strength training helps in perimenopause but you don't know where to start
  • You'd like to be with other women going through the same thing
  • Some weeks you have loads of energy and some weeks you have none

A six-week group

Strong and Calm is one of our six-week groups. It meets twice a week, once downstairs in the gym and once upstairs in the studio, with up to 8 people so Helen gets to know everyone. It runs in six-week cycles all year: the next starts Tuesday 10 November, and the one after that in the week of 11 January 2027. When your six weeks are up, you can carry on into the next cycle or move into any class on our regular timetable.

Tuesdays and Thursdays, 9:45am£50 for six weeks
Book your place

Can't make this cycle? Leave your details for the next one.

What happens in a session

Downstairs, in the gym

Strength

  • Check in. Tell Helen how you feel today: green, amber or red
  • Mobility. Hips, spine and shoulders
  • Strength circuit. Simple moves like sitting to standing, stepping up and lifting light weights
  • Stretch and breathe. Slow down before heading home
45 minutesUnheated
Upstairs, in the studio

Slow yoga

  • Settle. Arrive, check in and breathe
  • Gentle flow. Easing stiff, achy joints
  • Supported stretches. Long holds with blocks and bolsters
  • Bedtime breathing. Breathing to use at night, then rest
45 minutesUnheated
Workshop · Saturday 14 November, 10am to 1:30pm · £60

The Menopause Blueprint

A morning with Helen on what menopause does to your joints, bones, muscles and nervous system, and what helps: a talk, a strengthening flow, food and questions, then somatic yin and yoga nidra.

About the workshop

Questions

Do I need to be fit to join?

Not at all. When you arrive, you tell Helen how you feel today: green for full of beans, amber for so-so, red for running on empty. She shapes the session to match.

Is it hot yoga?

No. Both sessions are unheated. Hot flushes are quite enough heat, thank you.

Do I need a diagnosis?

No. If you think you might be in perimenopause, you're welcome. This is exercise and support, not medical advice, so speak to your GP about any symptoms that worry you.

When are the sessions?

Tuesdays and Thursdays, 9:45am, starting Tuesday 10 November. The six weeks finish on Thursday 17 December.

Is it a one-off?

No. The groups run in six-week cycles all year. The next cycle starts Tuesday 10 November, and the one after that in the week of 11 January 2027. You can join at the start of any cycle, and carry on from one to the next.

How do I join?

Book and pay online through our booking system, Gymcatch. You can use the app or book straight from your browser. If you'd like to ask a question first, text Helen on 07718 339510 and she'll get back to you.
